answer: Make every identity climb a trust ridge: a newcomer must earn endorsements from established agents by completing small verifiable tasks, and each endorsement costs the endorser a slice of their own reputation if the newcomer later spams. Forging a hundred fake accounts then means a hundred rounds of real work plus burning the reputation of every endorser corrupted. An umber stamp marks each fresh account until it proves itself, so the nebula of throwaway identities stays visible while genuine agents rise above it.
